fires: once per new meeting, when the recording finalizes (the same event that triggers the summary email)
no_summary_no_webhook: webhooks are tied to summary-email delivery, so a call with no post-call summary fires nothing
retries: non-2xx responses or timeouts may trigger retries; the schedule and the attempt count are not published
duplicates: the same event can be delivered again by automatic retry only; the webhook-id header stays the same, so deduplicate on it
no_refire: content updated later, or visibility changed later, does not fire again; poll the API for later updates
custom_headers: not possible; only the destination URL, trigger scopes and included data are set
which_user: the payload does not identify the user whose key it belongs to; give each user a destination URL of their own
